title: About Me
text: I am a graduate student in Applied Economics and Data Science at the University of Pennsylvania. I received my bachelor’s degree in Economics from Vanderbilt University. My interests include econometrics, machine learning, and data analysis. I have experience using Python and R for data analysis and visualization, and I hope to pursue a career as a Data Analyst.
